nodes.label: CRB3/FBX9 Signaling Axis (Mechanism)
nodes.norm_label: crb3/fbx9 signaling axis (mechanism)
nodes.rationale: Design/mechanistic rationale: CRB3 ligand engagement recruits the adaptor kinase FBX9, which phosphorylates downstream effectors driving collagen I/III transcription independently of the canonical TGF-beta/SMAD pathway targeted by existing antifibrotics. This non-overlapping mechanism is the stated rationale both for CRB3 antagonism as a novel antifibrotic target and for proposed combination therapy with standard-of-care agents acting via TGF-beta/SMAD.

nodes.label: hERG Cardiac Safety Signal (contested)
nodes.norm_label: herg cardiac safety signal (contested)
nodes.rationale: Contested finding: external academic study (LIT-007) reports hERG IC50 = 4.8 micromolar with a free-drug safety margin narrower than the 30-fold reassurance threshold; internal GLP hERG assay (IR-006) reports IC50 > 30 micromolar with a margin exceeding 30-fold, and the dedicated Phase 2 Holter/QTc substudy (CT-004) shows no clinical QTc signal at therapeutic doses. The in vitro numeric discrepancy between LIT-007 and IR-006 is explicitly acknowledged as unresolved by both IR-006 and CT-004 rather than dismissed or explained.
